mascot: Nomu the Elephant — a kind, gentle elephant who points his trunk at naming words: people, places, animals, and things.

slides.title: Naming Words! 🏷️
slides.text: Naming words are words that NAME something! Your name is a naming word. Ball, school, mummy — all naming words!
slides.spoken: Naming words name things: ball, school, mummy!

slides.title: Names of People 👩‍🏫
slides.text: Naming words can name people: mother, father, teacher, doctor, Ravi, Meena!
slides.spoken: Mother, teacher, doctor — naming words can name people!

slides.title: Names of Places 🏫
slides.text: Naming words can name places: school, park, market, hospital, Delhi, beach!
slides.spoken: School, park, market — naming words can name places!

slides.title: Names of Animals 🐘
slides.text: Naming words can name animals: elephant, tiger, parrot, cow, fish, ant!
slides.spoken: Elephant, tiger, parrot — naming words can name animals!

slides.title: Names of Things 🎒
slides.text: Naming words can name things: book, pencil, ball, chair, water, cake! Look around — how many naming words can you see?
slides.spoken: Book, pencil, ball — naming words can name things!

challenges.question: Which word is a naming word (a noun)?
challenges.hint: One of these names a thing you can touch!
challenges.misconception: Ball is a naming word — it names a thing! 'Run' shows action and 'blue' describes colour.

challenges.question: Which naming word names a PERSON?
challenges.hint: Who is someone you meet at school?
challenges.misconception: Teacher names a person! Pencil is a thing and park is a place.

challenges.question: Which naming word names a PLACE?
challenges.hint: Where do children go to study?
challenges.misconception: School names a place! Dog is an animal and spoon is a thing.

challenges.question: Which naming word names an ANIMAL?
challenges.hint: Which one roars and has stripes?
challenges.misconception: Tiger names an animal! Chair is a thing and river is a place.

challenges.question: Drag each naming word! Is it a person or a place?
challenges.hint: Doctor and mother are people. Market and garden are places!
challenges.misconception: Doctor and Mother name people; Market and Garden name places!

challenges.question: Drag each naming word! Is it an animal or a thing?
challenges.hint: Cow and lion are animals. Table and chair are things!
challenges.misconception: Cow and Lion name animals; Table and Chair name things!

challenges.question: Find the naming word in this sentence: 'The bird sings.'
challenges.hint: Which word names a living creature?
challenges.misconception: Bird is the naming word — it names an animal! 'Sings' shows action.

challenges.question: Which word is NOT a naming word?
challenges.hint: King and ring name things. One of these words shows an action instead!
challenges.misconception: Sing shows an action, so it is NOT a naming word! King and ring name things.

subject: english

storyArc.theme: An English explorer masters new words, one story at a time

beats.name: setup
beats.sceneDescription: The mascot welcomes the student and introduces the topic
beats.mascotDialogue: Welcome! Let us explore English together!

beats.name: inciting
beats.sceneDescription: A playful challenge appears that needs the new skill
beats.mascotDialogue: Here comes a challenge — can you work it out?

beats.name: rising
beats.sceneDescription: The tasks grow trickier as understanding deepens
beats.mascotDialogue: You are getting stronger! Try these!

beats.name: climax
beats.sceneDescription: The hardest test of the new skill
beats.mascotDialogue: This is the big one! Show me what you learned!
